title: Cargo Capacity Reached 24,327 Containers While Crews Shrunk
hook: Cargo capacity reached 24,327 containers while crews got smaller.
closing: Global shipments now depend on enormous vessels operated by surprisingly small teams.
question: Would you work aboard this ship?

segments.say: Cargo capacity reached 24,327 container equivalents. The largest ships now move far more in one trip.
The comparison ship measures 400 meters long. Modern container vessels operate at an immense physical scale.
A typical cargo crew fell to 20 people. Bigger ships did not require bigger teams.
